description: 对话练习：Story time + Cartoon time 完整对话，角色扮演跟读

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.english: Yuan Longping was a great scientist.
lines.chinese: 袁隆平是一位伟大的科学家。

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.english: He was born in 1930 in Beijing.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.english: He passed away in 2021 in Changsha.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.english: People call him "the father of hybrid rice".
lines.chinese: 人们称他为"杂交水稻之父"。

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.english: He liked farming at an early age.
lines.chinese: 他很小的时候就喜欢农业。

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.english: He studied farming when he grew up.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.english: In 1964, he began to work on hybrid rice.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.english: It was very difficult, but he never gave up.
lines.chinese: 这非常困难，但他从不放弃。

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.english: He worked hard and always stayed in the fields.
lines.chinese: 他努力工作，总是待在田地里。

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.english: He did lots of experiments.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.english: In 1973, he developed hybrid rice.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.english: Now hybrid rice grows in China and many other countries.
lines.chinese: 现在杂交水稻在中国和许多其他国家种植。

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.english: It feeds people all over the world.
lines.chinese: 它养活了全世界的人们。

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.english: Mrs Fox asked the class to write about their heroes.
lines.chinese: Fox老师让全班同学写关于他们的英雄。

lines.speaker: Bobby
lines.english: A famous scientist or inventor. They work hard and do great things.
lines.chinese: 一位著名的科学家或发明家。他们努力工作，做伟大的事情。

lines.speaker: Mum
lines.english: Hi, Bobby. I want to do the shopping for Mrs Pig.

lines.speaker: Bobby
lines.english: Can I go with you?

lines.speaker: Mum
lines.english: Sure.

lines.speaker: Mrs Mouse
lines.english: Hi, Bobby's mum. Thanks for taking my baby to the park yesterday.
lines.chinese: 嗨，Bobby的妈妈。谢谢你昨天带我宝宝去公园。

lines.speaker: Mum
lines.english: I'm happy to help.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.english: Bobby thought for a moment.

lines.speaker: Bobby
lines.english: You help Mrs Mouse with her baby.
lines.chinese: 你帮助Mouse太太照顾她的宝宝。

lines.speaker: Bobby
lines.english: You do the shopping for Mrs Pig every week.
lines.chinese: 你每周都为Pig太太买东西。

lines.speaker: Bobby
lines.english: You're always ready to help others.

lines.speaker: Bobby
lines.english: You're my hero, Mum!

lines.speaker: Mum
lines.english: Oh, Bobby! Thank you.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.english: Great people don't have to be famous. They can be the people around you.
lines.chinese: 伟大的人不一定非得出名。他们可以是你身边的人。
